name: emoji-picker
title: Emoji Picker
description: A popover with a quick row, search, a category bar, recents and a category-grouped grid of emoji that returns the selected character via onValueChange (curated set, loaded lazily).

meta.whenToUse: Lightweight emoji insertion — reactions, comments, status, icon selection.
meta.whenNotToUse: A complete Unicode emoji browser — extend the embedded set or use a library.
